grasp_hypothesis.scope:
Screen a hypothetical deeper rim grasp against flat placement geometry.

ISOLATED GEOMETRY ONLY. Translates the plate relative to a recorded hand pose
to represent moving the original rim grasp inward. The recorded hand/object
orientation is an explicit hypothesis, not predicted by physics. Restores the
complete isolated integration state; never runs dynamics or writes the source.
grasp_hypothesis.retained_orientation_assumption: Same as the recorded held object; must be remeasured in a fresh physical grasp.

route_probe.scope:
Query alternative Cartesian routes for the flat plate placement experiment.

Never approves the obstructed original joint path. Each alternate command curve
is checked by the original collision gates and returned explicitly in evidence.
This CLI restores isolated poses only and does not execute any trajectory.
route_probe.curve_source: original plan_pose_path and original collision gates
